link.0bbec6a67870.source: The cell produces an artifact. When you run it, you get a working chat panel rather than a wall of logs, rendered from the agent's own code, that you can hold a conversation with. The word itself is older than its current use, since build pipelines and machine-learning training runs have produced "artifacts" and "model artifacts" for years. Anthropic's recent live artifacts sharpened the idea for agents, where an artifact becomes a persistent, interactive HTML surface that the agent builds and that you keep using long after the reply which produced it. The panel below builds one on a small scale, and an agent that can hand back a full interface rather than plain text is a thread that runs through the rest of this course.
link.0bbec6a67870.value: 該單元格會生成一個製品。執行後，您得到的不是滿屏日誌，而是由代理程式自身程式碼呈現、可與之對話的聊天面板。“製品”一詞早在當前用法出現前就已存在，因為建置工作流程和機器學習訓練執行多年來一直會生成“製品”和“模型製品”。Anthropic 最近推出的 live artifacts 進一步明確了這一概念在代理程式領域中的含義：製品是由代理程式建置、可持久使用的 HTML 互動介面；即使生成它的回覆早已結束，您仍可繼續使用。下方面板以較小規模建置了一個這樣的製品。代理程式不僅能傳回純文字，還能交付完整介面；這一主題將貫穿本課程的後續內容。

link.18fdb5153bc7.source: Zoom in on the agent and you find the decomposition Lilian Weng drew in 2023. A language model sits at the center. Around it sit memory, planning, tools, and the actions that reach the world.
link.18fdb5153bc7.value: 仔細觀察代理程式，您會看到 Lilian Weng 在 2023 年提出的組成結構。語言模型位於中心，周圍是記憶、規劃、工具以及觸達外部世界的行動。

link.1be52ce4d6ee.source: Comprehensive list at Going Further · References.
link.1be52ce4d6ee.value: 完整列表請參閱深入探索 · 參考資料。

link.2b13321bec07.source: Redrawn from Liu et al. (2023). As the loop appends turns, the answer you need drifts into the weak middle.
link.2b13321bec07.value: 根據 Liu et al. (2023)的研究重繪。隨著迴圈不斷追加輪次，您所需的答案會逐漸移入模型表現較弱的上下文中部。

link.3535ae0b5666.source: Lilian Weng, LLM Powered Autonomous Agents (2023). The decomposition the figure above adapts: a language model as the agent's core controller, surrounded by memory, planning, and tool use.
link.3535ae0b5666.value: Lilian Weng，LLM Powered Autonomous Agents (2023)。上圖採用了該文的分解方式：語言模型充當代理程式的核心控制器，外圍是記憶、規劃和工具使用能力。

link.36832d4704f6.source: After Lilian Weng (2023): the model is the agent's core controller, with memory, planning, tools, and action wired around it.
link.36832d4704f6.value: 改編自 Lilian Weng (2023)：模型是代理程式的核心控制器，記憶、規劃、工具和行動圍繞它連線起來。

link.52c80043ccc5.source: An agent built on a language model runs the same perceive-reason-act loop as anything else, with one detail that gives the pattern its name: the model reasons in words between the actions it takes. Yao et al. (2022) called this ReAct, for reasoning and acting. They found that interleaving short reasoning traces with tool use handles many tasks more reliably than planning everything first or acting with no reasoning step.
link.52c80043ccc5.value: 基於語言模型建置的代理程式與其他系統一樣，執行“感知—推理—行動”迴圈。但其中有一個細節賦予了這一模式名稱：模型會在每次行動之間用文字進行推理。 Yao et al. (2022) 將這種結合推理與行動的模式稱為 ReAct。他們發現，將簡短的推理軌跡與工具使用交替進行，在許多工上比預先規劃全部步驟或不經推理直接行動更可靠。

link.64ae525d2a06.source: Wei et al., Chain-of-Thought Prompting (2022). The "reason" half of ReAct; what the model is doing inside reasoning_content when it deliberates before acting.
link.64ae525d2a06.value: Wei et al., Chain-of-Thought Prompting (2022)。這是 ReAct 中的“推理”部分，即模型在行動前進行斟酌時，在 reasoning_content 內部執行的過程。

link.6726ddaf5bfd.source: The loop above hard-wires one tiny tool. LangChain's createReactAgent generalizes the same machinery to support more tools, standard interfaces, and observability integrations. An instance of this class is wired below to a single tool, read_course_page, which hands the agent any page of this course as markdown. The model decides which pages to read for your question, so give it a try.
link.6726ddaf5bfd.value: 上面的迴圈硬編碼了一個很小的工具。LangChain 的 createReactAgent 對相同機制進行了泛化，可支援更多工具、標準介面和可觀測性整合。下方的課程執行個體只接入了一個工具 read_course_page，它可以將本課程任意頁面以 markdown 格式提供給代理程式。模型會根據問題決定讀取哪些頁面，請親自試一試。

link.7abcb40c63bb.source: Yao et al., ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (2022). The original alternating thought / action / observation pattern; the figure above is redrawn from this paper.
link.7abcb40c63bb.value: Yao et al., ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models (2022)。提出了最初的思考、行動與觀察交替模式；上圖根據該論文重繪。

link.9b74219a361f.source: Schick et al., Toolformer (2023). Covered again in 1c's references; revisit here for the underlying mechanism the ReAct loop exploits.
link.9b74219a361f.value: Schick et al., Toolformer (2023)。1c 的參考資料中還會再次介紹；此處可透過該論文回顧 ReAct 迴圈所利用的底層機制。

link.a733bbaab3fa.source: This issue becomes more likely as the context grows. Context rot is the tendency for contradictions, stale observations, and poor conventions to accumulate in the prompt history until the model's next decision gets worse. The effect also has a positional component: Liu et al. (2023) showed that models can underuse information buried in the middle of a long context. The further an important signal drifts from the current turn, the easier it is for the loop to ignore or contradict it.
link.a733bbaab3fa.value: 隨著上下文增長，這個問題更容易出現。上下文退化是指矛盾、過時的觀察結果和不良約定不斷積累在提示詞歷史中，最終導致模型下一次決策品質下降的趨勢。這種影響還與資訊所在的位置有關：Liu et al. (2023)的研究表明，模型可能無法充分利用埋藏在長上下文中部的資訊。重要訊號距離當前輪次越遠，迴圈就越容易忽略它或產生與之矛盾的結果。

link.a904f9e69da1.source: This loop is the foundation that most general-purpose agent frameworks are built on, LangChain's createReactAgent among them, and the rest of this module works up to it.
link.a904f9e69da1.value: 大多數通用代理程式框架都以這一迴圈為基礎，LangChain 的 createReactAgent 也是如此。本模組的後續內容將逐步建置這一迴圈。

link.e672069b0c2f.source: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations (2023). A deliberate contrast to ReAct: the model writes the whole plan up front and a separate executor runs it without re-querying the model between steps. Comparing the two reveals the trade-off between reactive replanning and pre-committed execution.
link.e672069b0c2f.value: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations (2023)。該方法有意與 ReAct 形成對比：模型預先寫出完整規劃，再由獨立的執行器執行；各步驟之間無需再次查詢模型。對比二者可以看出回應式重新規劃與預先確定執行方案之間的權衡。

rich.0a886834e9f1.source: Every chat-completions response carries a finish_reason field that tells you why the model stopped generating. Inside an agent loop, this is the only signal you need to decide what to do next: run a tool, return the answer to the user, or handle an error. Before reading what its values mean, make two calls and watch the field change.
rich.0a886834e9f1.value: 每個聊天補全回應都包含一個 finish_reason 欄位，用於說明模型停止生成的原因。在代理程式迴圈中，您只需依據這一訊號決定下一步操作：執行工具、向使用者傳回答案或處理錯誤。在瞭解各個欄位值的含義之前，請先發起兩次呼叫並觀察該欄位的變化。

rich.1cbfc5ef05f8.source: "stop" means the model has written its final answer and the loop can return content to the user.
rich.1cbfc5ef05f8.value: "stop" 表示模型已生成最終答案，迴圈可以將 content 傳回給使用者。

rich.32ec8d5bb853.source: The first call answered on its own and came back "stop". The second was offered a tool and asked for something training data cannot supply, so instead of stopping it came back "tool_calls", handing your code the name of the function to run. Those two values cover the common branching. The rest signal trouble that routes the loop into a fallback harness, where the agent might retry the call or hand the conversation off to a human.
rich.32ec8d5bb853.value: 第一次呼叫由模型自行作答，傳回了 "stop"。第二次呼叫向模型提供了工具，並要求獲取訓練資料無法提供的資訊，因此它沒有停止，而是傳回 "tool_calls"，將需要執行的函式名稱交給程式碼。這兩個值涵蓋了常見的分支情況。其餘值表示發生了問題，迴圈會轉入後備執行框架；代理程式可以在其中重試呼叫，或將對話轉交給人工處理。

rich.37cadcb11b30.source: Force the model to call the tool even when it does not need to. Try a question the tool genuinely cannot answer ("capital of France?") and watch finish_reason on step 1. Was it "stop" or "tool_calls"? Now edit the system prompt to require a tool call before answering ("You must always call get_current_time once, then answer."). Does the model comply? What does that tell you about how strongly the system prompt steers a model that has training-data confidence in another direction?
rich.37cadcb11b30.value: 即使模型不需要使用工具，也強制它進行工具呼叫。嘗試提出一個工具確實無法回答的問題（“法國的首都是哪裡？”），並觀察第 1 步中的 finish_reason。它的值是 "stop" 還是 "tool_calls"？現在編輯系統提示詞，要求模型必須先進行工具呼叫再回答（“您必須始終呼叫 get_current_time 一次，然後再回答。”）。模型是否遵從了要求？如果模型根據訓練資料對另一個答案方向很有信心，這一現象說明系統提示詞對模型的引導作用有多強？

rich.55b8f317ac62.source: "tool_calls" means the model is asking your code to run a named function and append the result before calling back.
rich.55b8f317ac62.value: "tool_calls" 表示模型要求程式碼執行指定函式，追加結果後再回撥模型。

rich.5dd2af0f718f.source: As an exercise, we can try to create a simple loop from scratch. All we need is a single tool named get_current_time plus one system prompt and one while loop. Run it with "What time is it in UTC?" to start, and see what else you can ask:
rich.5dd2af0f718f.value: 接下來嘗試從頭建立一個簡單迴圈。只需要一個名為 get_current_time 的工具、一條系統提示詞和一個 while 迴圈。先用“現在 UTC 時間是多少？”執行它，再看看您還能提出哪些問題：

rich.84d160e88d5a.source: "length" means the token budget ran out before the answer finished.
rich.84d160e88d5a.value: "length" 表示答案尚未生成完畢，token 預算就已耗盡。

rich.914091fc2532.source: Count the steps on a genuinely tool-needing question. "How many minutes until 17:00 UTC?" takes more than one tool call. Run it a few times. Did the model call get_current_time once, twice, or three times? Why would a model re-call a tool whose output it already has, and how would you discourage that in the system prompt?
rich.914091fc2532.value: 針對一個確實需要工具的問題統計執行步數。 “距離 UTC 17:00 還有多少分鐘？”需要進行多次工具呼叫。多執行幾次。模型呼叫了 get_current_time 一次、兩次還是三次？為什麼模型會再次呼叫已經取得輸出的工具？您會如何在系統提示詞中抑制這種行為？

rich.9cf78b159479.source: The flow is short: the model asks for the tool, the executor appends the timestamp as a tool-role message, the model reads that timestamp, and the loop exits when finish_reason reads "stop".
rich.9cf78b159479.value: 整個流程很短：模型請求使用工具，執行器將時間戳追加為一條 tool 角色訊息，模型讀取該時間戳；當 finish_reason 的值為 "stop" 時，迴圈退出。

rich.a5ec72e450db.source: A tool is code your harness can run for the model: a named function with a description, an input schema, and a return value. A tool call is the model's structured request for that code. The harness parses the request, runs the function, appends the result, and calls the model again.
rich.a5ec72e450db.value: 工具是執行框架可代模型執行的程式碼：一個具有名稱、描述、輸入模式和傳回值的函式。工具呼叫是模型發出的結構化程式碼執行請求。執行框架解析該請求、執行函式、追加結果，然後再次呼叫模型。

rich.a672cf1d58db.source: The modules are independent. You can replace the model or the tools or the router on its own, and as long as each one still honors the contract the others expect of it, the rest of the loop keeps working.
rich.a672cf1d58db.value: 這些模組彼此獨立。可以單獨替換模型、工具或路由；只要各模組仍遵守其他模組所依賴的契約，迴圈的其餘部分就能繼續執行。

rich.ac8be9f59109.source: Tools are the functions your harness exposes.
rich.ac8be9f59109.value: 工具是執行框架公開的函式。

rich.bd05de694d36.source: "content_filter" means a safety classifier stopped the output.
rich.bd05de694d36.value: "content_filter" 表示安全分類器停止了輸出。

rich.d43436ee347a.source: Action is the tool call the harness executes.
rich.d43436ee347a.value: 行動是執行框架執行的工具呼叫。

rich.d7a22d027748.source:
What just happened inside the messages array.
The loop pushed four things into state.messages:
  • the system prompt (turn 0),
  • the user question (turn 1),
  • an assistant message with a tool_calls field (turn 2, the request),
  • and a tool-role message holding the function's return value (turn 3).
The second LLM call read all four of those including the new tool result and wrote the final answer. The growing array is the only "memory" this agent has. If you saved that array to disk and reloaded it next week, the model would resume the conversation without noticing the gap.
rich.d7a22d027748.value:
剛才 messages 陣列內部發生了什麼。
迴圈向 state.messages 中加入了四項：
  • 系統提示詞（第 0 輪），
  • 使用者的問題（第 1 輪），
  • 一條帶有 tool_calls 欄位的 assistant 訊息（第 2 輪，即請求），
  • 以及一條儲存函式傳回值的 tool 角色訊息（第 3 輪）。
第二次 LLM 呼叫讀取了這四項，包括新增的工具結果，然後生成最終答案。這個不斷增長的陣列就是該代理程式擁有的全部“記憶”。如果您將該陣列儲存到磁碟，並在下週重新載入，模型會繼續對話，甚至不會察覺中間曾中斷過。

rich.dab40f3dcbce.source: Run the cell to build the panel, then chat with it. Pin one or more with the Pages chips to ground every answer in them, or pin nothing and let the agent choose what to read. The reply renders as markdown, with a chip for each source the agent read so you can expand it to see the text it pulled back. Alongside the answer, you also get the reasoning trace and the token usage. It remembers the conversation per chat. Edit the cell and rerun to rebuild the artifact.
rich.dab40f3dcbce.value: 執行單元格建置面板，然後與它對話。可以使用 Pages 標籤固定一個或多個頁面，使每個答案都以這些頁面為依據；也可以不固定任何頁面，讓代理程式自行選擇要讀取的內容。回覆會呈現為 markdown，併為代理程式讀取的每個來源顯示一個標籤；展開標籤即可檢視它檢索到的文字。除答案外，您還會看到推理軌跡和 token 使用情況。它會分別記住每個聊天中的對話。編輯單元格並重新執行即可重建制品。

text.e85366647d21.source:
The arrangement is strong because the model is never bound to the plan it
    started with. Whenever a tool returns something it did not expect, that result
    joins the next round of reasoning, and the model can reconsider where it stands
    before deciding what to do next.
text.e85366647d21.value: 這種設計的優勢在於，模型從不受最初規劃的束縛。每當工具傳回意料之外的結果時，該結果都會進入下一輪推理，模型可以重新評估當前狀況，再決定下一步操作。
